# graphiant_assurance_classified_application (Resource)

A custom application classification rule for data assurance (matches traffic by IP prefix/port/protocol).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graphiant_assurance_classified_application" "internal_erp" {
  app_name       = "internal-erp"
  ip_prefix_list = ["10.10.0.0/16"]
  port_list      = ["8443"]
  protocol_list  = ["tcp"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_name` (String)

### Optional

- `ip_prefix_list` (List of String)
- `port_list` (List of String)
- `protocol_list` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned classification entry ID (string, not numeric).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graphiant_assurance_classified_application.internal_erp <classification_entry_id>
```
